title: Comelec cannot set new poll date for postponed barangay polls — Garcia

blocks.text: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has no power to set a new date for the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (BSK) polls after the initial schedule of Nov. 2 was postponed, Chairman George Garcia said on Thursday.
